title: A BOUNTY THAT BURNS IS NOT YOUR KILL
why: The bounty pillager pays 1,500 only when you (or player 2) put him down: if something else kills him nothing is paid. The pay test asked whether his kill mark was anything but false, and a bounty no round has touched has no mark at all, so when he died in a fuel fire (he chases you and is held at a fire edge, where he burns) or under orbital debris, the game paid the full bounty and said BOUNTY CLAIMED. Every way a player kills him (rounds, frags, blasts, the air strike, barrels you set off) writes the mark as true, so the test now asks for exactly that. Proven in headless Chromium: a full health bounty nobody hit burned at a fire edge for 14 s, mark undefined, 1,500 paid with BOUNTY CLAIMED. Player 2 kills still claim it through the seat mark.
now: A bounty pillager killed by a fire, debris or a machine, with nobody shooting him, no longer pays the bounty.

edits.anchor: if(e.byPlayer!==false||(e.bySeat|0)>0){ flowChip(BOUNTY.pay,'BOUNTY CLAIMED','BOUNTY PILLAGER'); ev.d.won=1; }   // v27.27 (coop8): player 2's kill claims it too
edits.replacement: if(e.byPlayer===true||(e.bySeat|0)>0){ flowChip(BOUNTY.pay,'BOUNTY CLAIMED','BOUNTY PILLAGER'); ev.d.won=1; }   // v27.27 (coop8): player 2's kill claims it too. v16.xx (cloud-raid-bountyfire), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a bounty nobody hit that burns or is crushed by debris carries no kill mark, and that is not your kill
